logo.note: The Radix mark as radix-ui.com serves it (favicon-black.svg, and favicon-white.svg for dark grounds, which the site itself uses in dark mode), byte for byte from the radix-ui/website repository. WorkOS publishes no Radix logo guidelines; the website repository is MIT.

provenance.notes: The stylesheet is vendored verbatim as scripts/sources/radix/styles.css. The pack reads its sRGB custom properties at Radix's default settings (accent indigo, radius medium, scaling 100%).
